info.title: Voltium Fleet API
info.description:
REST API for the Voltium electric vehicle rental and fleet management platform.

## Authentication

Session-based JWT authentication. Tokens are set as httpOnly cookies on login and automatically sent with every request.

## Money Safety

All wallet mutations go through a double-entry ledger system with idempotency keys. Deposit approvals are idempotent — double-clicking will not double-credit.

## State Machines

All entity statuses are controlled by state machines defined in `docs/STATE_MACHINES.md`. Invalid transitions are rejected at the application layer.
